description:
Bootstrap-splash capabilities (tauri://localhost only — no remote.urls; the real web app's grants live in oidc-remote-deep-link.json, deliberately much narrower).

`allow-bootstrap-ipc` is not optional and not redundant: Tauri 2's app-command ACL is INERT until a crate ships its own permissions/*.toml, so this page called check_docker_* / start_stack_command for months with no grant at all. The moment allow-oidc-ipc was added for the remote origin, the check went live app-wide and the splash died on 'Command check_docker_installed_command not allowed by ACL' before it could run a single check. Any new command bootstrap.js starts calling has to be added there too.
